title: Mount the image viewer in the reader
acceptance: Tapping an image in an article presents ImageViewer full screen
It works while immersive and returns to the same scroll position
Captions in the article body render as captions, visually distinct from prose
Tapping an image does not interfere with markup drawing when the markup tool is active
notes: Phase 2 of the image viewer. Split out because ArticleBlockView.swift is a single-file bottleneck: T-0043 needs it to remove the per-block ink canvas, T-0041 needed it to mount the viewer, and the lease system correctly refuses to let two agents edit one file. Phase 1 builds the viewer standalone; this wires it in. The last criterion is the interesting one - once ink is document-level, a tap on an image must still mean 'open the image' when markup is off and 'draw' when it is on.

history.detail: attempt 1; the tap-vs-pen question is its to answer
